items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well my sense with George Wein was that he wanted, within his programming he wanted to have the broadest breadth of jazz represented. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: George Wein? Ok. And how was it received?
Oh, terrible! Everybody hated it. It was horrible.
